title: Surreal Cinema Scene
description: A purple-skinned woman with multiple eyes sits pensively in a red theater seat, hand on cheek, as a blue beam of light projects from her head toward a large movie screen. The screen displays a desert landscape with a backpacker, a motorcycle, a large red planet, and floating faces, while a small grey alien and a flaming motorcycle appear beside her amid purple smoke and geometric shapes.
